title: Proteogenomic insights suggest druggable pathways in endometrial carcinoma.

one_liner_zh: 该文是子宫内膜癌的多组学蛋白质基因组学研究，虽含深度学习预测亚型，但核心为临床肿瘤分型与药物靶点，无蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: We characterized a prospective endometrial carcinoma (EC) cohort containing 138 tumors and 20 enriched normal tissues using 10 different omics platforms. Targeted quantitation of two peptides can predict antigen processing and presentation machinery activity, and may inform patient selection for immunotherapy. Association analysis between MYC activity and metformin treatment in both patients and cell lines suggests a potential role for metformin treatment in non-diabetic patients with elevated MYC activity. PIK3R1 in-frame indels are associated with elevated AKT phosphorylation and increased sensitivity to AKT inhibitors. CTNNB1 hotspot mutations are concentrated near phosphorylation sites mediating pS45-induced degradation of beta-catenin, which may render Wnt-FZD antagonists ineffective. Deep learning accurately predicts EC subtypes and mutations from histopathology images, which may be useful for rapid diagnosis. Overall, this study identified molecular and imaging markers that can be further investigated to guide patient stratification for more precise treatment of EC.
abstract_zh: 我们利用10种不同的组学平台，对一个包含138个肿瘤和20个富集正常组织的前瞻性子宫内膜癌（EC）队列进行了表征。两种肽段的靶向定量可预测抗原加工和呈递机制活性，并可能为免疫治疗的患者选择提供信息。在患者和细胞系中，MYC活性与二甲双胍治疗之间的关联分析提示，在MYC活性升高的非糖尿病患者中，二甲双胍治疗可能具有潜在作用。PIK3R1框内插入缺失与AKT磷酸化升高及对AKT抑制剂敏感性增加相关。CTNNB1热点突变集中在介导pS45诱导的β-catenin降解的磷酸化位点附近，这可能使Wnt-FZD拮抗剂失效。深度学习能从组织病理学图像中准确预测EC亚型和突变，这可能有助于快速诊断。总体而言，本研究识别了可进一步研究的分子和影像标志物，以指导患者分层，实现更精准的EC治疗。
